title: Suspense ledger for unbilled usage and manual credit reconciliation for enterprise contract amendments
creator: Maya Patel
description: When enterprise customers request contract amendments (retroactive discounts, committed volume changes, or billing term changes) there are frequent gaps between usage already invoiced and final contractual adjustments. This ticket proposes a 'suspense ledger' flow: temporarily move disputed or unbilled usage to a suspense state, apply automated heuristics for small deltas, provide a clear manual reconciliation UI for finance/CS teams, and emit credits/refunds or ledger adjustments with audit trail. Scope includes the product playbook, UI wireframes for Console finance, API changes to billing service to mark usage as 'suspense', and automation rules for safety net credits. Out of scope: complete revamp of invoicing engine or tax/regulatory treatment logic (these will be handled by Finance ops with legal review).
acceptance_criteria: Design and product PRD published with sample UX flows and error states
Billing API accepts a new status 'suspense' for usage rows and exposes query endpoints
Automated heuristic: deltas under $100 or <5% of invoice line auto-mark for low-risk auto-credit and create scheduled refund with audit note
Manual reconciliation UI in Console allows finance/CS to review, adjust, and approve credits; actions are logged with operator and timestamp
Ledger export includes original invoice id, suspense id, reconciliation action, and final credit/refund transaction id
End-to-end test covering a contract amendment scenario where 3 customers are moved through auto-credit, manual-approve, and escalate-to-legal paths
Monitoring: dashboard with number of suspense rows, median time-in-suspense, and weekly backlog metric (must be <72 hours target for P1 customers)
Security and audit requirements validated with Security team (if required) and accessible in playbook
notes_or_progress: 2025-11-12: Kickoff with PM, Eng Billing, Finance ops, and CS. Recorded examples of 12 historical contract amendments with reconciliation pain points.
2025-11-14: Decision: implement dedicated 'suspense' status in billing DB rather than reusing 'pending' to keep audit semantics clean. Chosen to avoid ambiguous states during invoice runs.
2025-11-17: Trade-off discussion: automated heuristics limit default threshold to $100 to reduce false positives; agreed to make threshold configurable per org for Dedicated/Enterprise customers.
2025-11-19: Design reviewed — Console mockups show a new 'Billing > Suspense' tab with filters, inline notes, bulk approve action, and 'create credit' button prefilled by heuristic.
2025-11-21: Eng dependency flagged: requires new billing API endpoint and a non-disruptive migration script to mark historical unresolved rows. ENG-2390 owns API changes.
2025-11-25: Legal and Finance request additional audit fields (operator_role, reason_code). Added to schema proposal and acceptance criteria.
2025-11-26: Blocker removed — Finance agreed to handle tax/regulatory flags outside this initial rollout; we will include placeholders for tax metadata in ledger export.
billing_policy: Default heuristic: auto-credit deltas where amount < $100 OR delta_percentage < 5%. For enterprise orgs with contractual clauses, use org-level override configured by Finance. Manual approval required for refunds > $5k or for any change that affects reserved capacity billing. All actions must create a reversible audit entry and link to original invoice.
playbook_outline: 1) Intake: CS opens Contract Amendment ticket (link to amendment doc) and flags invoices to consider
2) System marks affected usage rows as 'suspense' during next billing cycle run
3) Heuristic engine evaluates each suspense row and either schedules an automated credit or queues for manual review
4) Finance/CS uses Console Suspense tab to approve/modify/decline; approval triggers credit/refund and ledger reconciliation
5) Escalation: rows older than 30 days auto-escalate to Legal & Finance with bundled report
